headline: Sallie Mae Falls Short of Third-Quarter Earnings Estimates
summary: Consumer banking firm Sallie Mae reported third-quarter 2026 earnings that missed Wall Street expectations, causing its shares to decline in trading.
why: Sallie Mae (SLM Corporation) is a major originator and servicer of private student loans in the United States.

impacts.name: SLM Corporation
impacts.why: Disappointing third-quarter earnings missed analyst forecasts, pressing share values lower.

why_moved: Earnings missed analysts' net income estimates, triggering sell-offs in SLM equity.
